text:
Lena (Docs): Heads-up: we're rolling the new docs search index and deprecating the legacy /v1/search endpoint. Plan to flip the indexer at 19:00 PT, deprecation banner goes live now. Please skim the rollout steps below and flag issues.
Tom (SDK): Which SDK calls are affected? Do we need a breaking change note?
Priya (Search): Only the legacy REST endpoint used by some older quickstarts. New approach uses the unified search API `GET /docs/search?q=` and the client helpers `client.docs.search()` for SDKs. We prepared migration snippets.
Lena (Docs): Migration snippet added to quickstarts PR. Also added a short FAQ for partners. Deprecation window: 60 days; old endpoint will 410 after that.
Jordan (Infra): Deploy bot: indexer job scheduled at 19:00 PT. Flag: we'll run a canary index on a subset of pages first.
deploy-bot: indexer job #442 scheduled 19:00 PT 00 pages canary.
Tom (SDK): I'll update JS and Go examples, link new helpers. Where's the code sample?
Lena (Docs): In the PR: https://redwood.example/pulls/3272. Example (short):
```
// old
const res = await fetch('/v1/search?q=intents');
// new (recommended)
const res = await client.docs.search({ q: 'intents' });
```
Tom (SDK): Nice. Will submit js-sdk#489 and go-sdk#207 today. No runtime break for people using the hosted SDKs, but raw REST users should update.
Priya (Search): Telemetry: we'll record search latency buckets and popularity counts, not response bodies. See privacy note in PR.
qa-bot: QA checklist added to PR: smoke tests, pagination, suggestions, redirects.
Lena (Docs): QA notes: I validated suggestions and pagination on staging. Two small issues: snippet copy button truncates long queries; and the banner CSS overlaps TOC on small screens. Filed bugs.
Jordan (Infra): Canary index completed: 200 pages, no errors. Rolling full index in 10. If errors > 0.5% we'll pause and rollback.
Tom (SDK): Quickstarts PRs linked. Please review so I can cut release notes.
Lena (Docs): Release notes draft in the PR. Key customer-facing line: "Improved docs search relevancy + unified search API. Legacy /v1/search deprecated; update within 60 days."
Priya (Search): Redirects in place: requests to /v1/search will 302 to /docs/search?q=... for 60 days then 410.
Lena (Docs): Post-deploy checklist: 1) Verify redirects 2) Verify banner shows 3) Update support KB 4) Send #general blurb.
Jordan (Infra): Full index run done, errors 0.12% (within threshold). Prod switch complete.
Lena (Docs): Post-deploy: prod search live, banner visible, support KB updated, #general announcement posted.
Tom (SDK): Released patched examples and added changelog entry: "Docs search: migrate to client.docs.search() - legacy endpoint deprecated".
Priya (Search): Privacy ack: no response payloads logged; org-level opt-out available for enterprise.
qa-bot: Automated smoke: suggestions and pagination passed.
Lena (Docs): Closing thread. If you find broken links or edge cases, reply here and we'll triage. Thanks :party_parrot:
